svg.title: What I have worked on, newest first
svg.text: Contract AI engineer for a healthcare certifier in Germany
The system checks uploaded certificates against what applicants typed into the form. I found valid certificates
scanned with phone apps being read as expired, so good applications would have been sent back. Every
document now gets a second, independent reading, and disagreements go to a person. The test set has 33 cases,
some of them forged on purpose.
Fixes merged into IPython and git-cola
Two more are in review, at icalendar and scikit-learn.
Led the Tareekh team at Hack with Hyderabad 3.0
Built Native for Smart India Hackathon 2026
22 tools. Works with the wifi off.
Started freelancing for a chemical manufacturer in Hyderabad
Staff asked their Excel data questions in plain English and saw the cell behind each answer. They used it every day
until the company moved to an ERP. I open-sourced the engine as ExcelMCP.
A weekend favour. Teachers at two schools ran it on 600 students' board results.
